title: Edition
description: master/<event_id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/edition.json: the categories of one edition (occurrence) of an event. The date is the directory name; each category's result TSV is <category_id>.tsv beside this file, and the edition has weather exactly when weather-data.json is there too.

categories.description: Array of race categories within this edition

SegmentColumnRole.description: Semantic role of this column within the segment

MetaColumnRole.description: Semantic role of this metadata column

columns.description: TSV column names belonging to this segment, in order. Maps denormalized TSV columns (lap times, split times, intermediate checkpoints) to their parent segment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the category within its edition; also the basename of its result TSV (<category_id>.tsv in the edition directory)

name.description: Name of the race category in Japanese

segments.description: Ordered array of sport segments defining the race format

description.description: Detailed description of the race category in Japanese

meta_columns.description: TSV columns for participant metadata, rankings, and status that are not part of any sport segment.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the upstream data source for this category's result_tsv (e.g. the JTU result page for the specific program). Null when unknown. Used to detect data-source mismatches/contamination.

source_ref.description: Source reference: identifies where this category's result_tsv can be re-fetched from (IRONMAN subevent UUID or JTU program id). Provenance metadata; not part of the normalized output.

results_source.description: Results source the id belongs to

id.description: IRONMAN subevent UUID (results_source=ironman) or JTU program id such as 436_3 (results_source=jtu)
